record.field: # Logic: Find subscriptions ending in 30 days # datetime and context are provided by Odoo expiring_orders = env['sale.order'].search([ ('date_order', '<=', (datetime.date.today() - datetime.timedelta(days=335)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')), ('state', '=', 'sale') ]) for order in expiring_orders: order.activity_schedule( 'mail.mail_activity_data_todo', user_id=order.user_id.id, note='Subscription potentially expiring soon. Use One-Click Upsell.' )
